KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

9. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain herufi kubwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
